_note_routing: The routing map: each seat once, with its real GitHub login (App seats as their bot login, people by handle; null = no GitHub login, reached in the inner loop only) and its nicknames as aliases. burst-live resolves every login against GitHub at startup and on each audit, refuses an unresolved entry and flags it on the board; GET /routing serves it read-only. Look a login up there before you @-mention anyone, never from memory. Logins verified against the GitHub users API on 2026-10-14: forge0x1[bot], critic0x[bot], herald0x[bot], arch10x[bot] exist; blinky has no App login found (null).

reviewer._note: pr_heads sends critic + blinky one line per new PR / head

arch1.reason: explicit @arch10x ask for Arch1 (outside the fleet)

forge.reason: CI / deploy failure, merge / deploy / Gate B run ask, implement / rebase / dev ask, or merge into main or bifrost/main; terminal railway deploy (op_deploy). Forge launches the cloud agent.

critic.reason: review request or Light / Strict / re-Light ask

blinky.reason: mention for blinky (wave plan, burn, Lane H, onboarding)

seats.critic: review ask: new PR or new head
seats.blinky: heads-up: new PR or new head

_note_pr_heads: every PR open / new head on a watched repo, mention or not; one line per seat per repo#number@sha (inbox_pass.py)
_note_handoffs: Who the packet goes to, and who owes sending it, for live-inbox --handoff. reviewer and merger name seats in this file. author is the PR author's seat. The server never posts the packet. A room post does not clear a missed handoff.
_note_extra_seats: extra_seats are routed by feed/inbox_pass.py (kinds / merge_bases / needles); every key is one of our 8 seats (feed/fleet-roster.json)
_note_builder_cloud: builder / builder-cloud are kit plumbing in app/server.mjs (installation-token auth, mirror); no route writes to them
_note_fallback: Actionable events whose lines all go to a seat outside our 8 (unknown, sample, unkeyed) also go to blinky (CoS). Lines to seats outside our 8 are dropped. Pulses never route. Arch1 is outside the fleet and reached only by an explicit @arch10x mention; his lines are never copied to blinky.
_note_comment_watch: Every PR/issue comment (incl. merged PRs) routes to blinky, and PR/issue comments also to the PR or issue author's seat (aliases on the author node), mention or not. @-mentions come from the collector's mentions[] (handles only, never bodies).
_note_seats: seats: the kit's role rules (reviewer / builder / tester / operator / coord, read by routing/inbox.py), each mapped to one of our 8 by "seat" (or "off"); inbox_pass.py rewrites every line to that seat. Kit defaults stay in inbox.py.
